ala.text: Eliza is one of the few living humans left on Grixis, and she waits outside the necropolis of Unx after luring its demonic master away with a story about a human hermitage.

Her scout warns that a rival army has massed on the other side of Unx, and she guesses its leader is the lich king Sedris, so she sends him her necklace as a ploy to get him face to face and has her fleshdoll ready her armies for war.

When the giant Traitor King demands that her minions serve him and ends her leadership, Eliza refuses, flings her sword into the necropolis wall, and casts her most powerful necromancy spell, which turns a mile-long skeleton into a skeletal fire-dragon.
Told by a ghost minion that there is no endgame for him, Sedris withdraws his troops, and Eliza collapses and declares herself baron of Unx.
